It is no secret that crypto currently represents the frontier of technological innovation.

In the last cycle, the game was simpler. Most of the activity happened on $ETH and Ethereum DeFi coins. Today we have more altcoins than ever before, and with more quality ecosystems than I can count with both of my hands. 

Many OGs will describe this cycle as the hardest so far. I only entered crypto in 2021, but I think this one is definitely harder too. From chasing airdrops the normal way to instead focusing on points farming with more or less already knowing the outcome and the size of the airdrop.

So far this cycle the biggest change is the dispersion in the space. We are conditioned to think that altcoins will pump together. But now there are probably 300 decent projects. There is not enough liquidity for all of them to pump.

Remember there are a lot more tokens with “utility” on the market today than in 2021. Every week now 3-5 “quality” coins are added to the market. Total3 mcap goes up, and everyone seems happy. But ask yourself who is going to buy all these tokens. Unless institutions or retail are coming in masses, it will just be a forever PvP fight.

New shiny coins are good (until the circulating supply increases).

Since investors are locked up for a long time on low float tokens, this means that when they finally start unlocking it will be a constant sell pressure on the market.

Okay, so more and more supply will hit the market as tokens unlock gradually.

But the question is: where is the demand? Who will buy the tokens that is getting dumped on you?

You could argue that because of narrative X, Y, and Z, the price will go up, increased TVL in a DeFi protocol, a bullish event, etc., and this can work for a while. But at some point, the supply will outnumber the demand and we will start spiraling downwards due to massive inflation.

Early buyers will get trapped, which leads to bearish sentiment among the community, reduced TVL in the protocol/protocols, devs (if any) leaving for greener fields, team members quitting, etc.

The new question for 2024 is this: If the yield/money is captured in the point farming phase, then why trade the token after it is launched at all?

Still curious about what will happen to eg. Ethena when their airdrop season 2 will finish. People are locking up USDe for points atm, but will they still hold it when there is no points left to farm? The staked version of USDe makes sense though because of the real yield (funding rate + ETH staking rewards). Not going to ponder more about this now, but let’s see what happens.

Given the plethora of information present in 2024, identifying signals from noise is the single most important skillset in driving returns. Our goal as investors is to maximize return over the long term. This does not mean that we need to maximize returns every waking moment.

With that said, I am not sure what's the best way to capture the most upside going forward. Being it memecoins, max longing $ETH , a few selected altcoin longs, pair trading with a basket of high FDV, low float tokens combined with the latest narrative longs, DeFi yield farming. In retrospect for the first 6 months of 2024 it looks like points farming, being a part of private phases of protocols and DeFi yield farming has been the best bets + ETH ETF trade/Van Eck SOL ETF and a few other news trading events.

I continue to be long on the industry I am logging into every single day to talk about with my degenerative friends. The tide will turn, eventually.

이더리움은 변동성 측면에서도 더 공격적인 성격을 보였습니다. 실현 변동성은 이더리움이 62.8%, 비트코인이 49.8%로 나타나며, 이더리움이 더 높은 베타 자산으로 작동하고 있음을 보여줬습니다. 두 자산의 상관관계는 약 0.94로 매우 높았지만, 유동성과 위험선호가 개선될 때 이더리움이 훨씬 더 민감하게 반응한다는 점에서, 시장 전체 방향성에 대한 확대 반응 자산으로 해석할 수 있습니다.

더 중요한 부분은 수급 구조입니다. 이더리움은 거래소 출금이 계속 이어지면서 시장 내 즉시 매도 가능한 물량이 줄고 있고, 이는 장기 보유 성향 강화로 연결되고 있습니다. 온체인 데이터도 이런 흐름을 뒷받침합니다. 코인베이스 프리미엄 갭은 여전히 마이너스지만 점진적으로 개선되고 있어, 미국 수요가 초기 회복 단계에 진입하고 있음을 시사합니다. 동시에 활성 주소 수는 계속 증가하고 있어, 네트워크 사용성이 실제로 확대되고 있다는 점도 확인됩니다.

「 $ETH の買い集めが活発化、取引所の資金フロー構造は市場の局面転換を示唆」

イーサリアムは現在、構造的に重要な局面に入っています。オンチェーンデータは、価格の動きと実際の資金の動きの間に乖離が生じていることを示しています。価格は依然として2,000ドル付近で押し込まれていますが、買い集め傾向のあるアドレスが保有する実現時価総額は増加し続けています。これは、価格が弱い局面において、追い上げ買いよりも長期的な需要が供給を吸収していることを示唆しています。

資金フローの観点から見ると、買い集め傾向のあるグループの実現時価総額が着実に増加しているということは、コインが過去の移動履歴が少ないウォレットへと継続的に移動していることを意味します。このような流れは、2025年4月の調整以降や、最近の調整中の安定局面で特に顕著に見られました。価格のボラティリティが高まったにもかかわらず、買い集め局面の解除が見られず、むしろさらなる買い集めにつながった点は、短期的な循環売買よりも確信に基づくポジショニングが強化されていることを示しています。

同時に、取引所への入金の構造もこうした変化を裏付けています。2025年半ばの上昇局面では、高頻度の入出金アドレスからの流入が大幅に増加しましたが、このような流れは通常、短期売買や局所的な高値付近での買い集め区間の解消と結びつくことが多いものです。一方、現在はこうした投機的な流入が減少し、中央集権型取引所から資金を引き出すアドレスの比重が高まっています。これは、資産が流動性の高い取引所の外へと徐々に流出しており、直近の売り圧力が低下していることを意味します。

また、極端な取引所への入金の急増が見られない点は、市場がまだ過熱していないことを示唆しています。現在、イーサリアムは供給が静かに強気な投資家の手に移る再買い集め局面に近づいているように見えます。もし取引所からの出金フローが続くならば、供給の縮小とともに、今後の上昇局面の可能性もさらに高まる可能性があります。全体的に見ると、現在のイーサリアムのオンチェーン構造は、価格の動きよりもファンダメンタルズが先に改善している様子であり、このような構造はしばしば、より大きな方向性の動きの前兆となることがあります。

동시에 거래소 입금 구조도 이런 변화를 뒷받침합니다. 2025년 중반 상승 구간에서는 고빈도 입출금 주소발 유입이 크게 늘었는데, 이런 흐름은 보통 단기 매매나 국지적 고점 부근의 매집 구간 해제와 연결되는 경우가 많습니다. 반면 현재는 이런 투기성 유입이 줄어들고, 중앙화 거래소에서 자금을 받아가는 주소의 비중이 더 커지고 있습니다. 이는 자산이 유동성 높은 거래소 밖으로 점진적으로 빠져나가며, 즉시 매도 압력이 낮아지고 있음을 의미합니다.

또한 극단적인 거래소 입금 급증이 없다는 점은 시장이 아직 과열되지 않았다는 뜻이기도 합니다. 현재 이더리움은 공급이 조용히 더 강한 손으로 이동하는 재매집 구간에 가까워 보입니다. 만약 거래소 출금 흐름이 계속 이어진다면, 공급 축소와 함께 향후 확장 국면 가능성도 더 커질 수 있습니다. 전반적으로 보면, 지금 이더리움의 온체인 구조는 가격 흐름보다 펀더멘털이 더 먼저 개선되고 있는 모습이며, 이런 구조는 종종 더 큰 방향성 움직임의 전조가 되곤 합니다.

I have never seen so many people capitulating out of $ETH or crypto.

Some are writing blogs and essays explaining why it failed, mainly naming how other chains won the race, measured by fees taken in. 

Some of my thoughts, in these hard times:

Time will tell, but I think many people are mistaken in treating $ETH like an end-stage $AMZN, as if the main question is already about mature margins, fees, and cash flows.

In reality, Ethereum is still very much earlier in its economies-of-scale phase, with nearly all metrics in the top right corner and growing at mid double digits to tripple.

Furthermore, most of the market is focused on the wrong battle: who can become the fastest and cheapest payment processor. 

Lower fees, higher throughput, faster settlement. But that is likely a race to commoditization, similar to the payment processors crash over the last years. 

If the only value proposition is speed and cost, then the moat gets thinner over time, easy disruptable. Someone can always be faster. Someone can always subsidize fees lower. Someone can always optimize one narrow use case.

The real value may not be in the transaction fee itself.

The real value is likely in the amount of economic activity secured by the network, the credibility of that security, the neutrality of the base layer, and the difficulty of replacing it once enough assets, applications, institutions, and users depend on it.

That is where Ethereum seems different to me and why so many institutions are choosing $ETH.

Most other projects still feel replaceable. They may have better performance in one area, better UX in another, or lower fees in the short term. But if their advantage is mainly technical efficiency, that advantage can be copied, competed away, or made irrelevant.

The newest hottest thing today is replacing the hottest thing from last quarter.

Ethereum’s bet appears to be much larger: become the most secure, decentralized, credibly neutral settlement layer for the internet economy.

Not the cheapest rail.
The hardest rail to replace.

In the end, the most valuable network may not be the one with the lowest transaction costs. It may be the one people trust most to secure the highest-value assets and applications over the longest period of time.

If $ETH can retain its market share while continuing to scale through upgrades that improve speed, throughput, and fees, its potential remains significant, especially if AI agents become truly crypto-native.

If it combines all of the above and earn the crown as the leading value-secured network, then $ETH could eventually be viewed as something like a truly decentralized, inflation-adjusting global bond: securing the world’s assets, free from political meddling, and deserving of a premium market cap because of the value it protects on top of the deflationary pressures create incentives to stake, get yield and trust the equivalent of buybacks and griwth in value secured to provide additional value.

Keep in mind over 1/3 of $ETH is now staked!

In that scenario, $ETH would not just be another asset to hold. It could become one of the only truly neutral and secure bonds for the digital economy.
